counting_rule: At least 15 substantive parish-specific articles per parish. Islandwide stories, incidental mentions, activity cards and proposed subjects do not count. Existing substantive local histories may satisfy a mapped subject after editorial review.
standard: Local chronology and named people or communities
Evidence tied to each historical claim; distinguish folklore and interpretation
Visuals beside the relevant passage with date, actual locality, creator and source
Relevant audio or film where available; never force an unrelated clip
A learning activity and connections to other local articles
Practical activities distinguish confirmed services from heritage sites needing arrangements
